functions.name: FURLRequestFilter
functions.signature: FURLRequestFilter(Config Section Root Name, Config File Name)
functions.docs:
Initializes the allowlist map based on ini configs. Example syntax:
[ConfigSectionRootName https]
!AllowedDomains=ClearArray
+AllowedDomains=epicgames.com
[ConfigSectionRootName http]
!AllowedDomains=ClearArray
+AllowedDomains=epicgames.com

functions.name: FURLRequestFilter
functions.docs: Initializes the allowlist based on an explicit scheme/domain map

functions.name: UpdateConfig
functions.signature: UpdateConfig(Target, Config Section Root Name, Config File Name)
functions.docs: Update the allow list by corresponding section in a config file

functions.name: IsRequestAllowed
functions.docs: Matches InURL against the configued list of allowed URL schemes and domains. Returns true if the URL is allowed.
